claim.summary: Over F2 in Braun's finite-parameter setting (m>0, l>=2, n=2^l, h=3l, complete old-affine family adjoined to Q_{m,l}), if the proper blocks of rank >h(k+1) are M coordinate blocks (input spans spanned by literals x_b+c_b) and either M<=k or, with r=h(k+1)+1 and V=2v (V=v under consistent pins), M prod_{i<t}(1-(r-l i)/V)<=k-t for some 0<=t<=k-1, there is no ordinary-PC refutation through any D>=2h+1 with 2k(D+1)-1<=n. So M such blocks are excluded through D=floor((n+1)/(2M))-1 when that is >=2h+1. For M<=k spread coordinate blocks of r bits in distinct rows with ln M>=-(kr/m)ln(1-1/l), the exact summed restriction ranks on L_k are >= dim L_k. Proof: fix one pinned bit per block in fresh rows (weight prod(x_b+c_b) in L_k with zero restriction); Braun's restriction-ideal lemma, weighted removal and row separation finish; Jensen for the spread bound. The saving is a cover by single literals.
claim.assessment: Working proof passed by the sole fresh-context medium reviewer with corrections (field F2, greedy inequality, qualified summed-rank range, worst-case-rank table, full-scan baselines, f=1 baseline and restriction reading); the degree comparison is from degree_range.json, l<=32.

claim.summary: In Braun's F2 setting, for M proper coordinate blocks each pinning at least r>l(k-1) bits, k>=1, with V=v under consistent pins and V=2v otherwise: if M prod_{i<t}(1-(r-l i)/V) <= k-t for some integer 0<=t<=k-1, a nonzero product of at most k affine forms x_b+c in distinct rows lies in L_k and has zero ordinary restriction to every flat. claim.summary: A binary safe bit-affine system of rank a<=cN, c<1/4, gives a degree-preserving restriction of flat avoidance plus any complete affine ENS family to a near-balanced affine PHP source.
claim.assessment: Working binary theorem using the concrete older safe-system map. Pairwise disjoint pivot-row coordinate edges map marked cells to u_i and 1+u_i, with all u_i affine, leaving N+1-a rows and N-2a holes. Every old-affine ENS family remains complete and affine, even if chosen after the flats; forced avoidance indicators have Boolean image certificates at their original degrees. The near-balanced endpoint excludes D<=N^alpha polylog N when log affine inventory<=N^beta polylog N and 2alpha+beta<1. A direct constant first-row map clamps each bottom with a safe probe equal to one, so the two-level old-affine-plus-product-sum source version has no bottom-rank or positive-accuracy restriction. Specified consistent deeper affine reference profiles are also covered. Compact and weak unary cases use the decoder and strengthening. Arbitrary polynomial inventories need not admit an affordable safe system, and the PHP substitution is specifically binary.

claim.summary: In Braun's F2 setting (m rows of l bits, v=ml, row-linear L_k of dimension H), for proper coordinate blocks pinning at least r bits each to constants (pins to one translate to pins to zero), with x=1-r/v, rho=(m-k+1)l/k and rho x>1, each restriction rank is at most H x^k rho x/(rho x-1) by Maclaurin's inequality and a geometric bound, so the exact summed count gives a common row-linear kernel when ln M < -k ln x - ln(rho x/(rho x-1)), with -k ln x >= rk/v. By prop:common-kernel-ceiling some family at the same k and r with ln M <= rk/(v-r-k)+ln(k ln(v+1)+1) has none: the main terms agree to a factor 1+O((r+k)/v), with additive gap about (rk/v)(r/2v+k/v), which grows at minimal degree D=6l+1 (341 at l=32). At l=16, D=107 (k=303, r=14593): certified 4.246 against the ceiling 12.62 and the published 1.40.
claim.assessment: Working proof passed by the sole fresh-context medium reviewer in its route-review stage 2 and follow-up, including the sandwich at every admissible parameter and the reproduced minimal-degree sweep. Coordinate blocks only; Braun's general affine flats are not covered.
